sources_used: Frasers Group plc FY21-FY25 Annual Reports + H126 results (https://www.frasers.group/investors)
_ordering_rationale: Retail UK : UK Sports Revenue (KPI maitre, joyau Sports Direct), Premium Lifestyle (Flannels), International, Property estate, Adj PBT.

kpis.signal: Joyau Frasers (Sports Direct UK), pression environnement consommation UK FY25, restructuration en cours
kpis.description_fr: CA segment UK Sports Frasers Group (Sports Direct UK + USC + Field & Trek). Pilier historique, joyau du modèle. Pression consommation UK FY25.
kpis.description_en: Frasers Group UK Sports revenue (Sports Direct UK + USC + Field & Trek). Historic pillar, model jewel. FY25 UK consumer pressure.

kpis.signal: Flannels luxury + House of Fraser + Frasers, pari haut de gamme depuis 2020
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Premium Lifestyle (Flannels luxury + Frasers + House of Fraser). Pari haut de gamme Mike Ashley depuis 2020, brand elevation.
kpis.description_en: Premium Lifestyle revenue (Flannels luxury + Frasers + House of Fraser). Mike Ashley's premium pivot since 2020, brand elevation.

kpis.signal: Expansion EU continue (Allemagne, France, NL), acquisitions agressives 2022-2025
kpis.description_fr: CA segment International Retail (Sports Direct EU + Game Digital + filiales). Expansion EU agressive 2022-2025.
kpis.description_en: International Retail revenue (Sports Direct EU + Game Digital + EU subsidiaries). Aggressive 2022-2025 EU expansion.

kpis.signal: Stratégie immobilière commerciale : Frasers détient ses propres murs (>900 M£ portefeuille)
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Property Estate Frasers (loyers immobilier commercial détenu). Stratégie 'own your real estate' Mike Ashley.
kpis.description_en: Frasers Property Estate revenue (commercial real estate rents owned). Mike Ashley's 'own your real estate' strategy.

kpis.signal: Pic FY24 atteint, pression FY25 sur volumes UK Sports + investissements digitaux
kpis.description_fr: Résultat avant impôt ajusté Frasers Group. Pic FY24 atteint, pression FY25 sur volumes UK + investissements transformation.
kpis.description_en: Frasers Group Adjusted Profit Before Tax. FY24 peak, FY25 pressure on UK volumes + transformation investments.

_notes: Frasers Group FY se termine fin avril. Sources : Annual Reports FY21-FY25 + H126 results. Mike Ashley (Founder) reste actionnaire majoritaire ~73%.
